title: FB-027 harden layout drawer focus and customize open behavior
summary: Fix FR-027 and FR-029 by making the closed layout drawer inert and making empty-state Customize open-only.
reason: Worker findings showed the closed Layout Editor drawer remained focusable and the empty-state Customize action used a retired class check that could close an already open drawer.
behavior_before: Closed drawer controls remained reachable off-screen, and empty-state Customize could toggle the drawer closed while the empty state was visible.
behavior_after: Closed drawer is hidden and inert, reset controls ignore closed state, and empty-state Customize only opens or refreshes the layout drawer.
manual_validation: Bundled Python with PYTHONPATH=src: python -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_layout_manager_smoke -q passed.
Layout-manager browser smoke passed; npm run webview:check passed.
Red layout-manager browser smoke failed on closed drawer not hidden before the fix.
rollback_plan: Restore the prior layout drawer open/close and empty-state customize behavior, then rerun layout-manager smoke tests.
notes: WebView UI behavior only; no backend mutation path changes. The layout smoke had stale Launch, Reports, and Completed label expectations updated to match the active markup while validating this drawer behavior.
